title: 宝塚記念の後に・さあ、コックピットへ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun overtakes her opponents at full speed and leaves her mark on the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next target is the autumn Tenno Sho! Her desire to blow past the competition with all her might is renewed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the same time, having witnessed Mayano Top Gun racing at full speed with her own eyes…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian leaves the racecourse with a fire lit in her heart.
